fingerprints.desc: increaseBet raises a backend-SIGNED betAmount but never checks msg.value escrow + the signature is replayable (no nonce) -> free bet inflation, betAmount decoupled from held ETH
a price consumer calls latestRoundData() but never checks updatedAt freshness -> a stale oracle price is accepted as current (mispriced collateral)
a value-moving op (borrow/swap/mint) is reachable while the protocol is paused though sibling ops are whenNotPaused-gated -> an incident-pause does not stop that path
